dataset_id: Statistical Bulletin, economic classification of expenditure, 2005-2012
indicator_name: Budget execution by the economic classification of expenditure in force until 2013 (state and republican budgets; subclasses, specifics), year-to-date, million KZT
description: Исполнение государственного и республиканского бюджетов по экономической классификации расходов, действовавшей до 2013 года (подклассы, специфики), с начала года, млн тенге
unit: million KZT, January to the month
methodology: Minfin Statistical Bulletin, PDF editions of 2005-2012 (yearly archives on gov.kz), read by fetchers/minfin_pdf.py: the table «Исполнение государственного бюджета по экономической классификации расходов» (subclasses; table 7 in 2005-2006, table 6 from 2007) and the same for the republican budget (with specifics; table 10). A SEPARATE DATASET FROM BUDGET_EXPENDITURE_ECONOMIC_YTD BECAUSE THE CLASSIFICATION WAS RENUMBERED FROM 2013: the same code is a different item on the two sides (130 is «Приобретение товаров» here and «Выплата заработной платы отдельным категориям граждан…» from 2013), so the two must not be joined by code and there are no GFS.* items here. Comparable across 2013 by name: TOTAL («Всего»), CAT1 current, CAT2 capital, CAT3 budget loans, CAT4 financial assets, CAT5 repayment of loans (TOTAL includes it), and 110 wages, 120 employers' contributions. Item <BUDGET>.<code>, STATE / REP; item_name is the label of the edition. Values are printed in whole millions. Checked in every edition: categories add up to «Всего» and subclasses to their category within the rounding of whole millions (half a million per term); a table that does not is not loaded. Loaded 2026-11-14: state budget 91 of 96 months, republican 88. Missing: April 2006 (the edition is not in the archive) and the tables that contradict themselves in the source -- state 2005-03, 2006-01, 2008-01, 2011-09; republican 2005-02, 2005-08, 2006-06, 2006-07, 2010-04, 2010-10, 2011-10 (docs/minfin_bulletin_pdf_2005_2012.md). Independent checks: «Всего» equals «ПОСТУПЛЕНИЯ» of the receipts table of the same edition in 151 of 152 budget-months loaded in both (the exception is state 2011-12: 6 288 321 against 6 288 306); December totals of 2008-2011 equal the earlier-year columns of the 2011-2012 spreadsheet editions. The daily run does not touch this dataset; it is loaded by scripts/backfill_minfin_bulletins.py --yearly 2005-2012. The editions of 2002-2004 follow the pre-2005 budget classification and are not read.
